resources.string: Reads the amount on WeChat and Alipay payment pages and in the \"WeChat Pay\" chat: payments made inside the app without a notification still get recorded, and entries whose notification had no amount (watch payments and the like) get it filled in. Only those two apps are read, and nothing leaves the phone.
Reads payment pages through accessibility to fill missing amounts
On in settings, but not running
With notifications alone, watch payments and \"sent you money\" entries need their amount typed in.
Opening a payment page or message in WeChat or Alipay records it and fills in the amount.
Turn it off and on again under accessibility; if that does not help, the system is blocking it.
Under accessibility → \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed services\", find \"Expense Tracking full auto\" and turn it on.
If it says \"Restricted setting\": app info → ⋮ at the top right → Allow restricted settings, then come back.
Paying inside WeChat or Alipay without a notification: recorded from the \"payment successful\" page, with the shop name.
Entries without an amount (watch payments, \"X sent you money\"): when you open that message or its details, the amount is filled in.
When the screen and the notification show the same payment, it is recorded once.

For entries without an amount: when the phone is unlocked on the home screen, opens that message for a few seconds, reads the amount and goes back home. One try per entry, never over the app you are using.

Helps improve recognition: kept only on this phone and deleted after 3 days; only lines with digits or payment words are kept, the rest become \"·\". It also notes what it can see when a screen cannot be read, and WeChat/Alipay payment notifications (from chats only transfers and red packets, without names).
Screens kept: %d. You can open the file before sending
%d samples will be deleted and cannot be restored. If you have not sent them yet, tap \"Send screen samples\" first.
No samples yet: turn it on, then look around the payment pages and messages in WeChat and Alipay
Only WeChat and Alipay screens are read (with \"Fetch amounts\" on, it also needs to know whether the home screen is in front). What is read is only used for your ledger and never uploaded.
The payment pages are matched from common app versions and may differ on your phone. If it is off, turn on \"Keep screen samples\" for a day or two and send them.
Reads the payment notifications of your payment apps and records amount and time. Your ledger stays on this phone.
No need to open the app after paying
Stats, budget and monthly recaps included
The capsule on the screen edge
Each new entry shows a small capsule on the edge of the screen that tucks itself away after a few seconds.
Tap it to change the category or add a note; tapping a category saves
Light purple capsule = no amount (watch payment…): tap and pick a usual amount
Drag to switch sides, long-press to hide
Without them no payment notification reaches the app. Tap one to turn it on; this page refreshes when you come back.
Keeps the system from stopping it
Some phones also need autostart / background permission: Settings → Automatic recording → Self-test & background settings.
When a notification has no amount (watch payments, \"sent you money\"), turn on \"full auto\" under accessibility and the amount is read from the payment page or message.
You can also turn it on later under Settings → Automatic recording → Full auto.
Swipe an entry left to delete, right to change its category, long-press for more
Swipe the top card on the home page to change month
Tap the cards on the stats page for forecasts, habits and the year in detail
Home-screen widgets: one tap records a usual amount
Missed one? Settings → Ledger → Import bills to reconcile
